findings.title: Missing JSON-LD schema on services page
findings.description: The /services route has no JSON-LD schema markup. Adding Service schema improves AEO eligibility.
evidence: No <script type='application/ld+json'> found in services page response
Competitors ranking for the same queries all include Service schema
findings.requiredOutcome: Add Service JSON-LD schema to the /services route response headers or template

findings.title: robots.txt disallows /api/ paths
findings.description: The robots.txt Disallow: /api/ rule blocks crawlers from discovering API endpoint pages referenced in the sitemap.
findings.requiredOutcome: Remove or narrow the /api/ Disallow rule to avoid blocking sitemap-listed pages

findings.title: Consider adding FAQ schema for common questions
findings.description: A FAQ schema block could appear in rich results for common question queries. Not a current defect — a future enhancement.
findings.requiredOutcome: Add FAQ schema in a future sprint once content is finalised
